candidate: Experimental v8 / native extension 1.5.3; installed Orqanix app unchanged
implementation: Guarded whole-line replacements preserve local LF/CRLF and original range terminator by default, including a terminated EOF; empty replacement deletes a full range.
replacement_mode=exact retains byte-exact joins and deliberate ending changes. LSP planned edits remain exact.
One coherent batch/check guidance, no optional formatting/diagnostics after success; ordinary tools remain available. No automatic test-success cache, task classifier or deferred schemas.
AST/LSP remain optional under existing off-by-default nativeGemsEnabled; no OMP.
comparison: Same rebuilt Rust release binary in actual Orqanix Electron app, mode off/on, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Jev/Axwise/Code Mode off, two repetitions per task/arm; same frozen driver and synthetic fixtures as v7.

traceFindings.renameWorkflow: First candidate used one guarded 14-file custom batch; second used ordinary shell/write tools. Neither called LSP. The first pair took 34.1% less time; the second pair was about 1% longer. Do not credit the paired median reduction to LSP or claim uniform repeatability.
traceFindings.remainingLatency: Most elapsed time overlaps primary provider requests. AST and guarded batch execution took milliseconds. Additional tool/prompt context or output generation may contribute, but this experiment does not isolate the cause of provider latency.
traceFindings.testFailures: Two pre-change regression checks correctly failed before guarded edits; both final task grades passed. No native tool errors.

functionalValidation.recipeIssue: Print-only self-test commands let a missing argument remain in the model-generated consumer after a signature change. Independent pinned TypeScript compilation caught it. LF/CRLF/delete/exact-byte checks passed. Do not treat receipt verification alone as source-quality proof.

recommendation: Retain boundary fixes behind the optional flag. Use default workflow for routine work; selectively enable batch capabilities when useful. Do not promote Native tools mode as a general speed improvement. Reduce tool/prompt overhead and require actual project/compiler checks before future promotion.
limitations: Two repetitions per task/arm are exploratory; no statistical equivalence or universal quality/speed claim.
Aggregate equally weights three fixtures, not a measured daily workload.
Historical v4 21.1% and v7/v8 absolute timings are different batches; cannot attribute changes between them solely to the code.
The repair cycle did not recur, but code normalization and guidance changes were combined, so causal effects were not isolated.
Additional functional recipe failed independent quality grading despite passing receipt checks; failure retained.

normalStartupCheck.diagnosis: Chromium cookie-key load waits before TCP/TLS. Normal startup of the newly ad-hoc-signed test bundle has not been cleared by the earlier v7 approval. No inference or Send; does not change twelve task timings. Keychain/dialog state was not inspected; do not assert that a password is missing.
normalStartupCheck.benchmarkStartup: Disposable profiles used the same test-only mock cookie Keychain switch in both arms; real parent OAuth used normal approved Keychain and TLS pinning was unchanged.
